name: parspec-pptx
description: Parspec .pptx generation — editable PowerPoint / Google Slides decks built with python-pptx from the design-model.yaml SSoT. Two registers: brand_artifacts (13.333in, drawn chrome, L1–L12) and townhall (the company's own town hall template, 10in, with KPI tiles, funnels, process chevrons, question/evidence rows). Headless LibreOffice render-and-verify loop; PowerPoint daemon optional.
